name: Awesome Delivery Scheduler for WooCommerce
author: awesomeplugins91

sections.description:
Awesome Delivery Scheduler adds simple delivery date and time slot selection fields to WooCommerce checkout.
You can define time slots, block specific weekdays or dates, and customize labels for your customers.

Features:
* Add delivery date picker to WooCommerce checkout
* Add delivery time slot selection
* Set minimum lead time (days before delivery)
* Set maximum selectable days
* Block specific weekdays
* Block specific dates
* Fully customizable labels and date formats
* Easy to use admin interface
* Works with any WooCommerce theme

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/awesome-delivery-scheduler directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Delivery Slots menu in the WordPress admin to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
Can I block specific weekdays for delivery?

Yes, you can select which weekdays to block in the plugin settings.

Can I block specific dates for delivery?

Yes, you can block individual dates in the plugin settings.

Can I customize the labels for the delivery fields?

Yes, you can set custom labels for both date and time fields.

Does it work with all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.
